source_note: REAL DATA. ERCOT real-time settlement point prices (MIS report 13061, 15-minute intervals), load zones LZ_HOUSTON, LZ_NORTH, LZ_CPS, LZ_AEN, for each replay preset's Chicago-local date and the day after. Exported from data/snapshot/ercot_rt_2025_hubs.parquet by web/mock/export_prices.py. Everything else the mock API serves is simulated.
ts_note: ts_utc is the interval start in UTC; ts_local is the same instant in America/Chicago.
